history.recommendation_text: The Board recommended that the Administration enhance centralized technical monitoring of ICT security at the entity level and establish accountability mechanisms to ensure full compliance with the security-related policies and standards.
history.administration_response: Pursuant to recommendation 5 contained in the report of the Joint Inspection Unit on cybersecurity in the United Nations system organizations (JIU/REP/2021/3), comprehensive information, including on resource requirements, was submitted in the report of the Secretary-General on capital investment planning (A/77/519). In that report, the Secretary-General provided detailed information on ICT spending globally across the Secretariat, including ICT capital expenditure and a capital investment plan, investment to support new modalities of work, upgrades and enhancements to the standardized access control systems for physical security, a comprehensive action plan for dealing with cybersecurity, ongoing and planned projects to improve the accessibility of premises, and investment in conference facilities to deal with the impact of the COVID-19 pandemic. Please refer to this report as evidence. The General Assembly took note of, but did not endorse, the Secretary-General’s report.
history.board_assessment: Given that the resource requirements for this enhancement have been identified and taken note of, the Board considers the recommendation to be overtaken by events.
